lines: d40: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Wyatt Robles is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d40: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d40: 🕯️ Wyatt is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d40: Thornfield watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)
d40: 🕯️ Wyatt Robles is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d40: What Wyatt kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d40: "Wyatt's gone." Tiana looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Wyatt." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d40: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Hien blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Steady Hands (Level 1). Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
d40: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Soft Step (Level 1). Move through woods like weather. Less noise, fewer surprises.
d40: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d40: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Wyatt Robles, 40 days. The mantle passes to Hien Hanh.
d40: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Hien Hanh, 58 — a piano tuner. Their hands know different work now: Green Whisper, Echo Location, Purify.
d40: The village's quarrel was with Wyatt — and Wyatt is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d40: At the grave, Jenny, Tiana, Werner and 3 more speak for Hien — "Wyatt trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d40: The fire knew Hien before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.

d61: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d61: 🕯️ Hien is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.
d61: Thornfield watches to see if Haven holds without its dead — and presses the tribute down to 3,000 kcal/week while the chair is empty. They'll test the link. Count on it. (Trust -8.)

d61: 🕯️ Hien's funeral feast: 1,500 kcal from the pantry, and every shaken fire is fed — Thornfield. The village mourns together, and the links hold because the dead are honored, not because the grief was forgotten. (Trust mended — the -8 bought back with grain.)
